summary: Design-only specification of Choros's append-only per-tenant hash-chained audit floor: audit_event (per-tenant monotonic dense seq, DB-level no-UPDATE/DELETE via privilege-revoke AND no-mutate trigger, per-tenant prev_hash/row_hash chain over a vocab-pinned canonical preimage) + audit_head (one forward-only head per tenant, atomic with the append, externally anchorable). Inherits T-0013 tenant isolation verbatim; fixes the canonical-preimage formalism, the seven verifier defect classes (tamper/reorder/insert/delete/gap/dup/fork), and 20 CI-checkable acceptance criteria. DDL/triggers/verifier/snapshot-job land in T-0053 + dependent build tasks.
functional: FR-1 audit_event is an append-only per-tenant tenant table (privilege-revoke AND no-mutate trigger; structural not discipline)
FR-2 per-tenant monotonic dense seq under per-tenant (not global) append serialization
FR-3 per-tenant hash chain: prev_hash=row_hash(seq-1), row_hash=H(canonical_preimage), genesis constants
FR-4 per-tenant forward-only head snapshot (audit_head), atomic with append, externally anchorable
FR-5 stateless per-tenant verifier detecting 7 defect classes (tamper/reorder/insert/delete/gap/dup/fork)
FR-6 canonical serialization + H + genesis pinned to vocab_version; any change = chain-format migration
FR-7 governance fields (type/actor/subject/scope/via/proposed_by/confirmed_by) first-class and hash-covered; grant events are rows
non_functional: NF-1 structural append-only, not discipline (CI-visible schema/privilege diff to defeat)
NF-2 per-tenant, zero cross-tenant contention (no global seq/lock/head)
NF-5 canonicalization stability (deterministic, length-unambiguous, NULL-distinct, JSON-canonical)
out_of_scope: SQL DDL/migrations/RLS policy bodies for audit_event+audit_head (T-0053)
append path + per-tenant serialization implementation (T-0053 + build tasks)
HSM custody / hardware key management (tier-gated, not day-1)
tenant isolation apparatus itself (owned by T-0013, consumed not redefined)
event taxonomy semantics / which events get audited (E3.x; grant model is T-0018)

acceptance_criteria.text: app role UPDATE on audit_event fails (privilege or trigger); row unchanged
app role DELETE on audit_event fails (privilege or trigger); row present
no-mutate trigger bars UPDATE/DELETE even for table owner (defense in depth)
append-only is structural: ci/checks lint fails if app role granted UPDATE/DELETE or trigger absent
seq is per-tenant dense+unique; UNIQUE(tenant_id,seq) rejects duplicate
append serialization per-tenant not global; N concurrent appends -> N distinct dense seq; no global lock/sequence
genesis: seq=GENESIS_SEQ row has prev_hash=GENESIS_PREV_HASH
chain linkage: prev_hash[n]=row_hash[n-1] for every n>genesis
row_hash=H(canonical_preimage) recomputed independently; preimage deterministic+length-unambiguous
preimage/hash vocabulary pinned to vocab_version; golden-digest snapshot test forces explicit bump on change
verifier detects all 7 defect classes (tamper/reorder/insert/delete/gap/dup/fork); clean chain verifies ok
verifier is stateless and per-tenant (no DB/network/global state; tenant-A ok while tenant-B tampered)
exactly one audit_head row per tenant; head names latest (seq,row_hash)
head advances forward-only; backward/skip update rejected by rule/trigger
append+head update atomic; head never names a non-durable row (rollback removes both)
head externally anchorable; verifier fork-check flags live-head != anchored-head at same seq
audit_event+audit_head in known_tenant_tables fixture; FORCE-RLS default-DENY tenant-scoped (reuses T-0013 probes)
tenant_id leading column of every PK/composite-index/FK on both tables
governance fields are first-class columns AND in the preimage (editing confirmed_by changes row_hash)
grant-issuance event maps onto audit_event columns with no schema change (E3.6 = rows in this floor)
